units: Mishp. 11 בָּחַרְתָּ ביסורים יותר וכ׳ thou didst prefer sufferings to poverty. Mass. Sof’rim XIII, 9; a. e.—Part. Hof. מוּבְחָר chosen. מן המ׳ of the best, the best way.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 1:3">Bicc. I, 3</cite>; a. fr.—<he>מצוה מן המ׳</he> the most preferable way of performing a religious act.
B. Kam. 78ᵇ; a. fr.—מ׳ מן המ׳ the very best.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:1:11">Y. Pes. VI, 33ᵇ</cite> top <he>מ׳ דוחה וכ׳</he> for doing a thing (in the Temple) in the preferable way, you may set aside (the Sabbath law); for doing it in the best way, you dare not &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="B00484"><he>אבחר</he></cite> <cite ref="Job 29:25">Job XXIX, 25</cite>) <he>הייתי שואלו וּמְבַחֲרוֹ</he> I was in the habit of investigating and examining it; [ed. Fr. emends <he>ומְבַהֲרוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="B00190"><he>בָּהַר</he></cite>].
